svg.title: Mouse · Black
svg.desc: Compact black laboratory mouse with deep eumelanin-rich fur, large rounded pinnae, pointed muzzle, fine paws, and a thin tail. Biological basis: Black mouse coats reflect strong eumelanin deposition along the hair shaft while the small-bodied Mus musculus proportions remain unchanged.
